close_reason: Belongs in jmap-types, not metadata-server. The PatchObject deserialize contract is a foundation-crate concern.
description:
Trigger: handle_metadata_set's update branch deserialises patch_val as PatchObject (metadata.rs:410). The PatchObject type lives in jmap-types. If PatchObject deserializes from anything non-object permissively (e.g. accepts an empty object), the test at metadata.rs:856-871 ('non-object patch returns invalidPatch') passes for the 'string' case but does not exercise the 'object with non-string keys' or 'null' edge.

This is a defensive-coding concern about the broader PatchObject deserialize contract, not metadata-server-specific. Filing here to track but the fix likely belongs in jmap-types.

Closing — not metadata-server's job to police PatchObject's deserialize contract. Confirmed below.
title: MemoryBackend.update_object enforces RFC 8620 §5.3 'patch-on-non-Object value' weakly: PatchObject deserialize at metadata.rs:410 catches the top-level non-object case, but no test asserts the wire shape of resulting SetError
